# Interactive assembly data

[Project overview](../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Scene and mesh assets generated by the shared cad-agent viewer.

Open the [local 3D viewer](http://localhost:8765/_cadagent/kit/viewer.html) or the embedded model in the [design review page](http://localhost:8765/site/#design-review).

Each variant includes the housing, native PCB, ribbon, clamp, hardware, mating connectors and optional legend paint. Use the part controls, explode slider and section tools to inspect the assembly. Regenerate with `.venv/bin/cad-agent view` after all STEP exports and readback checks finish.

These JSON/mesh files are browser assets. Use [STL/3MF](../README.md) for printing and [native KiCad](../../hardware/README.md) for electrical edits.
